e30cfb8ba1edc9e966d6.en: The short hand shows the hour. The long hand shows the minutes.
e30cfb8ba1edc9e966d6.id: Jarum pendek menunjukkan jam. Jarum panjang menunjukkan menit.

7df59674f979e92fac55.en: When the long hand points to 12, it is o'clock.
7df59674f979e92fac55.id: Saat jarum panjang menunjuk ke 12, itu berarti o'clock (jam tepat).

e9a378382c8f5f409760.en: When the long hand points to 6, it is half past.
e9a378382c8f5f409760.id: Saat jarum panjang menunjuk ke 6, itu berarti half past (lewat setengah jam).

0ee46487d42c94ad5f83.en: At half past, the short hand is halfway to the next number.
0ee46487d42c94ad5f83.id: Saat half past, jarum pendek berada di tengah jalan menuju angka berikutnya.

35b161638dbcb2307f20.en: The long hand points to 12 and the short hand points to 7, so it is 7 o'clock.
35b161638dbcb2307f20.id: Jarum panjang menunjuk 12 dan jarum pendek menunjuk 7, jadi waktunya 7 o'clock.

75ec38bbf7f9eccb6530.en: The long hand shows the minutes. Read the short hand for the hour.
75ec38bbf7f9eccb6530.id: Jarum panjang menunjukkan menit. Baca jarum pendek untuk tahu jamnya.

880ebf3f82fa62b89a78.en: At half past, the long hand points down to 6.
880ebf3f82fa62b89a78.id: Pada half past, jarum panjang menunjuk ke bawah, ke angka 6.

4e63ae27d763704b0db5.en: The long hand points to 6 and the short hand is just past 4, so it is half past 4.
4e63ae27d763704b0db5.id: Jarum panjang menunjuk 6 dan jarum pendek sedikit lewat dari 4, jadi waktunya half past 4.

3bf74ef35e5e4a9c3e48.en: The short hand has gone past 4, but not past 5.
3bf74ef35e5e4a9c3e48.id: Jarum pendek sudah melewati 4, tetapi belum melewati 5.

5e5cedd3149236413e47.en: The long hand on 6 means half past, not 6 o'clock.
5e5cedd3149236413e47.id: Jarum panjang di angka 6 berarti half past, bukan 6 o'clock.

cab9c5667dd93ca04783.en: At 3 o'clock the long hand is on 12 and the short hand is on 3.
cab9c5667dd93ca04783.id: Pada 3 o'clock, jarum panjang ada di 12 dan jarum pendek ada di 3.

55eefc1ad59357169778.en: At half past 7 the long hand is on 6 and the short hand is between 7 and 8.
55eefc1ad59357169778.id: Pada half past 7, jarum panjang ada di 6 dan jarum pendek ada di antara 7 dan 8.

1ba9850e12acac30fe61.en: Half past is half way round the clock, so the minute hand points to 6.
1ba9850e12acac30fe61.id: Half past berarti setengah putaran jam, jadi jarum menit menunjuk 6.

9433b221dcf0fe96d1cf.en: The long hand on 12 means o'clock. The short hand shows the hour, which is 3.
9433b221dcf0fe96d1cf.id: Jarum panjang di 12 berarti o'clock. Jarum pendek menunjukkan jam, yaitu 3.

37545638183d31fda53e.en: The long hand on 6 means half past. It is o'clock only when the long hand is on 12.
37545638183d31fda53e.id: Jarum panjang di 6 berarti half past. Waktunya o'clock hanya kalau jarum panjang ada di 12.

58cf215dcce68ef3c1ab.en: Half past means the long hand is on 6, halfway round the clock.
58cf215dcce68ef3c1ab.id: Half past berarti jarum panjang ada di 6, setengah putaran jam.
